test_episode_save_files: run the script to validate pickle and JSON episode save files contain matching data

test_approx_equal: test the approx_equal function to compare two values with a configurable epsilon tolerance

review_get_comp_value: review the get_comp_value function that converts NumPy scalars to standard Python scalar types
